patterns: The quadcopter consistently drifts or is blown too far to the left and low when approaching each gate, colliding with the bottom-left corner or left vertical post of the gate frames.

In failed flights, the drone gets stuck against or strikes the left side of the gate frame (hitting Gate 1's left post at 9 s in Flight 3, and getting hung up on the left posts of Gates 1, 2, and 3 in Flight 4 until timing out at 25 s).
parsed.summary: 2 of 4 flights passed (Flights 1 and 2 landed softly on the pad at ~13 s and ~19 s after clearing all 3 gates, despite briefly brushing the left gate posts). Across all flights, the controller exhibits a persistent leftward/low bias on gate approaches: Flight 3 failed at ~9 s when it drifted left and struck the bottom-left frame of Gate 1 (0 gates cleared), and Flight 4 failed by timing out at 25 s after repeatedly getting stuck against the bottom-left posts of Gates 1, 2, and 3 (2 gates cleared).
